business_summary: DL Holdings Group Limited, an investment holding company, engages in the financial services of licensed businesses in Hong Kong, the Cayman Islands, the People's Republic of China, and internationally. It operates through Financial Services of Licensed Business; Family Offices Services Business; Money Lending Services; Sales of Apparel Products; Enterprise Solutions Services; and Digital Finance segments. The company offers financial advisory services on corporate finance; securities research; securities trading and brokerage; margin financing services, including provision of stock-secured financing for retail, corporate, and high-net-worth clients; investment management and advisory services, such as management of investment portfolios and asset allocation of offshore funds; and insurance brokerage services. It also provides referral services to financial, biotechnology, and manufacturing sector clients comprising advising, sourcing, and referring investment targets and investors to institutional funds; connecting projects with clients and buyers with clients; and coordinating, advising on, and executing fundraising projects. In addition, the company offers family office services and asset management services; equity pledge financing and money lending services; enterprise solutions services, such as global identity planning and wealth inheritance consultancy services, and other business consultancy services; and digital finance services, including cryptocurrency mining services. Further, it engages in the sale of apparel products with the provision of supply chain management solutions; and property investment activities. The company also operates in the United States, Japan, and Singapore. The company was formerly known as Season Pacific Holdings Limited and changed its name to DL Holdings Group Limited in March 2020. DL Holdings Group Limited was founded in 2013 and is headquartered in Wong Chuk Hang, Hong Kong.
business_summary_ko: 투자 지주 회사인 DL Holdings Group Limited는 홍콩, 케이먼 제도, 중국 및 국제적으로 허가 받은 기업의 금융 서비스에 종사하고 있습니다. 라이센스 사업의 금융 서비스를 통해 운영됩니다. 패밀리 오피스 서비스 사업; 자금 대출 서비스; 의류제품 판매 엔터프라이즈 솔루션 서비스; 및 디지털 금융 부문. 회사는 기업 금융에 대한 금융 자문 서비스를 제공합니다. 증권 조사; 증권 거래 및 중개; 소매, 기업 및 고액 고객을 위한 주식 담보 금융 제공을 포함한 마진 금융 서비스; 투자 포트폴리오 관리, 역외펀드 자산배분 등 투자관리 및 자문 서비스; 및 보험 중개 서비스. 또한 투자 대상 및 투자자에게 기관 펀드에 대한 조언, 소싱 및 추천을 포함하는 금융, 생명 공학 및 제조 부문 고객에게 추천 서비스를 제공합니다. 프로젝트를 고객과 연결하고 구매자를 고객과 연결합니다. 기금 모금 프로젝트를 조정, 조언 및 실행합니다. 또한, 패밀리오피스 서비스도 제공하고 있습니다.
